title: RBAC v2 permission regression harness + audit-backed golden fixtures
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a deterministic regression harness for RBAC v2 that combines golden permission fixtures with correlated audit-log playback and SSO/SAML assertion scenarios. The goal is to catch regressions in permission evaluation, admin control enforcement, and audit emission before they reach staging or production. This ticket covers fixture schema evolution, deterministic seeding of test users/service-accounts, integration with existing CI, and a chaos mode for intermittent failure simulation (clock drift, partial KV cache loss, stale SAML tokens).
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible set of golden fixtures (JSON fixtures) covering 150+ permission scenarios (users, groups, service accounts, admin overrides) that can be run locally and in CI
Automated playback that replays requests and verifies: authorization decisions, emitted audit entries, and SAML/SSO session traces
CI gate that fails build on divergence from golden outputs or missing audit entries
Chaos injection modes (clock skew, KV cache miss, token-expiry) exercised in nightly runs with documented tolerances
Clear remediation notes for any regression (failing fixture, expected vs actual, minimal repro), and opened PRs for fixes
tasks: Design golden fixture schema with stable IDs and canonical timestamps (deterministic stamping)
Implement fixture generator that creates user/group/role graphs and expected authorization outcomes
Extend audit pipeline test harness to capture and compare audit events by correlation IDs
Add SAML assertion replay harness to simulate IdP responses (valid, expired, bad-audience)
Integrate harness into CI as a pre-merge smoke check and nightly full regression job
Create chaos injection layer to simulate KV cache loss, partial kernel fallback, and clock drift
Author runbook for interpreting failures and a one-click rerun with extra debug logging
Write a migration guide for new fixture schema for other teams to consume
test_plan: Unit tests for fixture generator (schema validation, idempotency)
End-to-end CI job: deploy test runtime image -> load fixtures -> run replay harness -> assert decision matrix and audit parity
SAML scenarios: valid sign-on, expired assertion, clock-skewed assertion, audience mismatch
Admin control checks: role escalation attempts, emergency admin hold, permission revocation and immediate enforcement
Regression smoke: run a 25-scenario fast subset on PRs, full 150+ scenarios nightly
Nightly chaos run that marks tolerated failures separately from hard regressions
rollout_plan: Stage: land harness and fixture generator behind feature flag in staging CI
Canary: enable full fixture runs against a staging cluster replica for 48h
Prod: enable pre-merge smoke checks on main branches and nightly regression in production-like environment
Monitoring: add a dashboard that shows golden-diff count, last successful run, and top failing fixtures
Kill-switch: feature flag to disable harness hooks if false positives flood CI
last_run_results: 2026-03-05: Nightly full run found 3 regressions: 1) admin read bypass for cross-tenant audit view (investigating), 2) session expiry mis-eval under clock skew (patch in PR#4321), 3) missing audit entry for service-account token refresh (root cause: emitter backpressure). Two issues have fixes in review.
